verdict.rationale: The SDK supports agent composition via handoffs, agents-as-tools, and Runner-based execution with sync/async/streamed modes, and guardrails can run in parallel with agent execution, giving basic branching and delegation primitives. However, there is no evidence of an explicit graph/workflow builder with native loop constructs or declarative branching—composition is done imperatively in code rather than via a dedicated graph API. missing for 10: explicit graph/workflow definition API, native loop primitives, declarative parallel-step orchestration beyond guardrails, independent corroboration of complex multi-branch workflows.
